description: Implementation of CurrencyReadPlatformService for retrieving currency data from the database, including methods to retrieve allowed currencies, all platform currencies, and a specific currency by code.

classes.name: CurrencyReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing currency data retrieval logic.

classes.name: CurrencyRowMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper to map SQL result set to CurrencyData objects.

methods.name: retrieveAllowedCurrencies
methods.description: Retrieves list of allowed currencies from 'm_organisation_currency' table.

methods.name: retrieveAllPlatformCurrencies
methods.description: Retrieves list of all platform currencies from 'm_currency' table.

methods.name: retrieveCurrency
methods.description: Retrieves a specific currency by its code.

methods.name: mapRow
methods.description: Maps a SQL ResultSet row to a CurrencyData object.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Returns the SQL schema string for currency fields.
